subject: Forecast prep: weekly cleanup sprint for Q3 opportunities
content:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast prep: weekly cleanup sprint for Q3 opportunities

Team —

We need to lock down Q3 forecast inputs for our top 18 deals by EOY ARR. Quick cleanup sprint this afternoon to make sure amounts, product mapping (SKU), next-next-steps, and probabilities are accurate in the CRM. Goal: reduce exposed ARR variance for finance review on Monday.

Plan (1–2hr focused work):
- Ben: update amounts and line-item notes for deals assigned to you (marked in the sheet).
- Karthik: confirm product/SKU mapping and flag any multi-SKU bookings that need split lines.
- Lauren: reach out to any opportunity owners with missing next-step or stale dates (template below).

Attached: Q3-deals-cleanup-template.xlsx (tabbed by owner) and product_sku_map_v2.pdf

Please reply in-thread once you finish your assigned items. If you cannot complete today, list blockers and ETA.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast prep: weekly cleanup sprint for Q3 opportunities

On Thu, Apr 26, 2028 at 9:12 AM Tessa Morgan wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We need to lock down Q3 forecast inputs for our top 18 deals by EOY ARR. Quick cleanup sprint this afternoon to make sure amounts, product mapping (SKU), next-next-steps, and probabilities are accurate in the CRM. Goal: reduce exposed ARR variance for finance review on Monday.

Done my pass for the 6 deals assigned to me. High-level notes:
- ACME-187: Amount updated from $280k to $320k after confirmed upsell; probability moved to 65% based on demo feedback.
- NIM-42: left amount as-is (still waiting on final SOW), put a high-priority placeholder note and set probability to 40%.
- DELTA-09: split booking into two SKUs per Karthik's previous mapping; see row comments.

Attachment: updated tab (Ben_Carter_updates). I left comments where I need a product SKU verification or procurement date.

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast prep: weekly cleanup sprint for Q3 opportunities

Thanks Ben — good updates. Quick clarifications from SKU side:
- DELTA-09: confirmed split should be SKU-A (core inference) + SKU-C (dedicated support). I updated the product_sku_map_v2.pdf and annotated the sheet.
- NIM-42: Nimbus requested an add-on (real-time kernels) — this is a separate line and should be modeled as a 6-9 month seat uplift; if Ben expects close in Q3, mark the add-on as conditional revenue with 25% probability until SOW signed.

Two asks:
1) Ben — can you get the expected procurement PO date from Lisa at Acme by EOD? If it's in May, we need to shift probability down and move recognizing to next quarter for forecasting.
2) Lauren — please ping opportunity owners for the three deals with stale next-step (rows G12:G14) and update CRM next action + planned meeting date.

Karthik
Principal Product Specialist, Inference
Redwood Inference

- OP-81: owner confirmed a POC demo scheduled 2028-05-07; updated next-step and left a comment about delivery timeline.
- OP-84: no response yet; leaving an owner escalation note and tagging CS for assistance.

I also consolidated everyone's updates into the master tab and saved as Q3-deals-cleanup-template_FINAL.xlsx in the Drive link above. Summary attached.

Lauren Bishop
